notes.title: Summer Picnic Sale!!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8561388/69a368c6078f9ab4ff050793f48995e4fd2c6e49.jpg[/img]
Boneless Zombie is currently [b]90%[/b] off for the Steam Summer Picnic Sale until July 4th.
If you haven’t had a chance to get your copy yet now’s your chance!

Actually all of Zoo’s games are on sale this weekend for up to [b]90%[/b] off.
Check out the full list of [url=http://store.steampowered.com/search/?publisher=Zoo%20Corporation]Zoo’s games[/url].

notes.title: Halloween Sale!!
notes.content:
Boneless Zombie is currently [b]95%[/b] off for the Steam Halloween Sale until November 2.
If you haven’t had a chance to get your copy yet now’s your chance!

Actually all of Zoo’s games are on sale this weekend for up to [b]95%[/b] off.
Check out the full list of [url=http://store.steampowered.com/search/?publisher=Zoo%20Corporation]Zoo’s games[/url].


現在、Boneless ZombieがSteamハロウィンセールとして[b]95%[/b]OFF実施中です。
まだご購入いただいていないあなたへのビッグチャンス！

さらに、Zooが提供する全商品が、ハロウィンセール期間中、なんと最大[b]95%[/b]値引きいたします！
今すぐ[url=http://store.steampowered.com/search/?publisher=Zoo%20Corporation]Zoo商品リスト[/url]をチェック！
